name: rot-dtd-goal
description: RoT DTD GOAL - a /goal engine where completion is earned by re-running real acceptance criteria, not declared by the model. Simultaneous verification, clock-free flake scoping, a fenced trust boundary, a dependency-ordered goal queue, and a Lean 4 specification the kernel re-verifies.

plugins.name: rot-dtd-goal
plugins.description: Pure bash + coreutils. A Stop hook re-runs every acceptance criterion and refuses to let the session end until each one exits 0 -- and refuses again if the evidence is stale, if a check cannot fail, if a check kept passing while its files were damaged, or if a criterion passed and then failed against the same seal. No network, no API key, no Lean toolchain required to run it.
